inline_text:
Edits to the Single Agent Human Approval reference architecture (RA) and Proposal Execution Split pattern docs, based on feedback from @geemus review in #45.

Summary of changes:
1. Re: Comment 1, Is "separate" really necessary? Clarifying what separation IS necessary vs prior ambiguous language.
    1a. RA - Purpose section: Refined language to make it clear that "separation" is focused on authority vs process.
    1b. RA - Structure section opening: Added 1 line clarification to section open, reinforcing how to read the section below (capability roles vs deployment topology).
    1c. Pattern - "Implementation approaches" table (new example): Added example from Anthropic Claude Agent SDK to show Orchestration/Harness-level instance of proposal execution split (`canUseTool`)

2. Re: Comment 2, "'enforceable behavior at point of effect' reads as the only reasons"...
    2a. RA - Purpose section: added more examples of potential side effects, clarified examples are non-exhaustive
    2b. Pattern - Problem section: added "any one of which" and non-exhaustive callout to list

3. Re: Comment 3, "'more than one independent agent?' reads as exhaustive; misses critique-isolation"...
    3a. RA - "Is this your architecture?" checklist, Question 1 - Refined to: Is a single agent producing the proposal a human approves?
